A triad colour scheme contains 3 colours. Considered to be the most basic type of color scheme, a triadic color scheme is defined as any three colors located 120 degrees from each other on the color wheel. In some way, triadic schemes can be considered the most flexible of the three combination-types, as there are many directions you can go in to measure 120 degrees.
